IC3: Capable of giving informed consent and complying with study procedures
IC4: Reports drinking a minimum of 5 standard drinks for men or [OR] 4 standard drinks for women on at least 4 days per week on average over the past 28 days
IC5: Meets DSM-V criteria for [AND] current Alcohol Use Disorder
IC7: Agree to not seek additional treatment, apart from Alcoholics Anonymous
